
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/19141047" title="发布于 2025-10-14 14:36">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">浅谈InheritableThreadLocal---线程可继承的小书包</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在前文中我们讲过ThreadLocal，相当于是每个线程有一个小书包，线程之间的小书包是隔离的，只存放了属于当前线程自己的变量，因此不会发生数据安全的问题。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><em>（前文博客浅谈ThreadLocal----每个线程一个小书包&nbsp;&nbsp;https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/19118986）</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">但是有时任务太繁重时，父线程希望new出新的子线程来为自己的业务提供帮助，同时希望子线程在处理时，也能用到自己保存在ThreadLocal中的变量。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">现在有三种办法：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（1）直接把父线程的ThreadLocalMap传递给子线程，让子线程直接拿去用</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">如：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sonThread.threadLocals=parent.threadLocals</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（2）父线程在创建子线程时将子线程需要用到的ThreadLocal数据，专门指定。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">如：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> Thread sonThread=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Runnable() {
            @Override
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run() {
                threadLocal1.set(xxx1); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">手动指定</span>
                threadLocal2.set(xxx2); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">手动指定</span>
                threadLocal3.set(xxx3); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">手动指定</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
        });</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（3）将父线程中threadLocals 中的数据，打包整理后，统一传递给子线程。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第一种显然不行，如果两者指向了相同的Map 会导致缓存数据被共享，父子线程存在并发读写，又会导致安全问题。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">方法二虽然灵活，但是指定起来过于繁琐，每个子线程都要单独设置一遍。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">java选用的是方法三，但是实现起来稍有不同：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">java 定义了一个InheritableThreadLocal类。通过这个类来实现线程可继承的ThreadLocal</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">定义中的：</span><br><em><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">Inheritable  [ɪn'herɪtəbl]</span></em><br><em><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">adj.   可继承的，会遗传的</span></em><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">InheritableThreadLocal指可以继承/遗传的ThreadLocal。接下来看源码：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在Thread类中，定义了以下属性：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    ThreadLocal.ThreadLocalMap inheritableThreadLocals = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>; </pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">类似于thread.threadLocals，这是给InheritableThreadLocal 来存储可以继承的属性的Map。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">InheritableThreadLocal类的源码，它继承了ThreadLocal：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> InheritableThreadLocal&lt;T&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extends</span> ThreadLocal&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * Creates an inheritable thread local variable.
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InheritableThreadLocal() {}

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * Computes the child's initial value for this inheritable thread-local
     * variable as a function of the parent's value at the time the child
     * thread is created.  This method is called from within the parent
     * thread before the child is started.
     * &lt;p&gt;
     * This method merely returns its input argument, and should be overridden
     * if a different behavior is desired.
     *
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> parentValue the parent thread's value
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> the child thread's initial value
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T childValue(T parentValue) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parentValue;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * Get the map associated with a ThreadLocal.
     *
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> t the current thread
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ThreadLocalMap getMap(Thread t) {
       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t.inheritableThreadLocals;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * Create the map associated with a ThreadLocal.
     *
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> t the current thread
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> firstValue value for the initial entry of the table.
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createMap(Thread t, T firstValue) {
        t.inheritableThreadLocals </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ThreadLocalMap(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, firstValue);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">通过源码我们可以发现，它的用法和实现与ThreadLocal基本相同，但是它重写了父类（ThreadLocal）的几个方法：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（1）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">首先是getMap(),重写的目的是当需要操作map对象时，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )请使用inheritableThreadLocals而不是再是父类中的t.threadLocals写法，这样所有使用的map就都切换到了</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"> ThreadLocal.ThreadLocalMap inheritableThreadLocals这个属性上来了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（2）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">其次是createMap() 方法，该方法的主要目的是初始化Map对象</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这里强调了初始化的是 t.inheritableThreadLocals 属性。为啥没直接用getMap() 方法来获取 t.inheritableThreadLocals呢？这是由于 t.inheritableThreadLocals 还没有初始化，返回是null，你调用getMap()没有意义。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（3）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">最后是 childValue() 方法，它是指当发生继承动作时，父类中的存储的变量转化为子类对象的转化转换。这里直接抽象成方法了，方便大家重写自己的InheritableThreadLocal类时，可以直接重写该方法。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">如我们想前边加一个标签，代表是子线程专用，亦或者进行翻译转换等等，总之方便你自己实现转换。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">来看下继承动作具体是怎么操作的：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">继承主要发生在主线程创建子线程程时，我们来看下Thread的构造方法源码，经过一堆跳转最后会跳转进这个方法：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread(ThreadGroup g, Runnable target, String name,
                   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackSize, AccessControlContext acc,
                   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inheritThreadLocals) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">....</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (inheritThreadLocals &amp;&amp; parent.inheritableThreadLocals != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.inheritableThreadLocals =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                ThreadLocal.createInheritedMap(parent.inheritableThreadLocals);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Stash the specified stack size in case the VM cares </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.stackSize =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackSize;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Set thread ID </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.tid =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nextThreadID();
    }
    </span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">方法参数中的boolean inheritThreadLocals表示是否要继承/遗传。手动创建的线程，这里都会是true，代表要继承/遗传。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">parent.inheritableThreadLocals != null 判断父线程的inheritableThreadLocals 属性是否为null （是否初始化了），如果不为null（父线程有需要遗传的本地变量），才发生遗传动作。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">条件都满足则发生遗传，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )入参为父线程的遗传本地变量，也就是属性inheritableThreadLocals。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">之后进入ThreadLocalMap的构造方法，开始构造子线程的inheritableThreadLocals 属性：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ThreadLocalMap(ThreadLocalMap parentMap) {
            Entry[] parentTable </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parentMap.table;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> len =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parentTable.length;
            setThreshold(len);
            table </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Entry[len];

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Entry e : parentTable) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    @SuppressWarnings(</span>"unchecked"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    ThreadLocal</span>&lt;Object&gt; key = (ThreadLocal&lt;Object&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) e.get();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (key != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                        Object value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>.childValue(e.value)</strong></span>;
                        Entry c </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Entry(key, value);
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> h = key.threadLocalHashCode &amp; (len - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (table[h] != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                            h </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nextIndex(h, len);
                        table[h] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c;
                        size</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    }
                }
            }
        }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">方法中就是遍历父线程的Map生成子线程自己的Map.Entry 了。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这里注意，</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在获取Entry的key 时，通过entry.get() 拿到父线程的Map 的key的弱引用，强制转化为ThreadLocal类型即可。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在获取value 值时，调用的是key的childValue()方法，也就是InheritableThreadLocal.childValue()中重写的方法，将父线程的value值转为子线程的value时。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这样子线程中:</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">1、map初始化好了；</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">2、entry元素也通过父线程都转移到子线程中了；</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">3、获取的遗传map，使用的都是遗传map了。（通过getMap()重写）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">map的get set remove 等核心逻辑都直接使用父类的逻辑。（因为InheritableThreadLocal继承自ThreadLocal，并且没有重写这段逻辑）</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">总体上了来说，ThreadLocal，InheritableThreadLocal的实现都非常的优雅，不但很好的利用了对象的继承，保证用户在使用时无感知的发生了继承。其次用户在自定义自己的InheritableThreadLocal class时，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )也只需要完成如何转化即可。非常值得我们自己在设计类结构和关系时参考这里的细节设计。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">类关系整体的结构如下：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704073/202510/704073-20251014143106361-1119393781.png" alt="Itlleitu" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">除此之外，我们也可以通过源码发现InheritableThreadLocal的一个特性，就是属性的遗传来自于父InheritableThreadLocal的全量属性，是不能根据某个线程自定义的。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">并且在遗传时，子线程是在被new出实例时，就已经获得了此刻全部的属性，如果父线程后续调整了InheritableThreadLocal的范围，子线程是感知不到的。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">来看这样一个例子即可</span>：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        ThreadLocal</span>&lt;String&gt; tl1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InheritableThreadLocal&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        ThreadLocal</span>&lt;String&gt; tl2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InheritableThreadLocal&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        ThreadLocal</span>&lt;String&gt; tl3 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InheritableThreadLocal&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        tl1.set(</span>"t1"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        tl2.set(</span>"t2"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Thread sonThread </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Runnable() {
            @Override
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run() {
                String s1 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tl1.get();
                String s2 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tl2.get();
                String s3 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tl3.get();
                System.out.println(</span>"out:" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s1);
                System.out.println(</span>"out:" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s2);
                System.out.println(</span>"out:" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s3);
            }
        });
        tl2.set(</span>"newTl2Value"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        sonThread.start();
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出如下，所有的值都是在new 子线程时就已经发生了，而并不是在子线程start之前：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">out:t1
out:t2
out:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
